home.welcomeBody: MyArcheryDiary is your archery notebook, always at hand. Like a real notebook lying on your desk, it keeps track of every session: training, coaching, competitions and strength work.
home.purposeBody: Writing down what you do, regularly, is the best way to understand what works. MyArcheryDiary helps you plan your sessions, review them and follow your progress throughout the season.

audience.question: Who is MyArcheryDiary for?
audience.answer: Archers of every level who want to keep track of their practice, and their coaches: an archer invites their coach, who then follows their journal of the current season.

start.question: How do I get started?
start.answer: Create an account with your email, Google or Apple, then open your first journal. All that is left is to write down your sessions.

journal.question: What is a journal?
journal.answer: A period you name, usually a season. It gathers the events dated within that period in a calendar you can decorate and colour month by month.

events.question: What can I write down?
events.answer: Training, coaching, competitions and strength work, plus four types of your own. Each event has its sheet: scores, arrow count, feelings, photos…

planning.question: Can I plan my sessions ahead?
planning.answer: Yes: for a day to come, note the duration, place, discipline, distance and objective. The review is filled in once the session is over.

progress.question: Where can I see my progress?
progress.answer: The Stats page shows your scores, arrow volume and physical and mental feelings, next to the goals you set yourself.

devices.question: On which devices?
devices.answer: Phone, tablet or computer, in your browser, in French or English.
